"""One explicit launch family for the shared episode loop.

The binding routes a selected concrete assignment. Resource operations and
result reads contain no model, resource selection or investigation loop.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import base64
from copy import deepcopy
import hashlib

from pathlib import Path

from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.domain import identity
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.execution_contracts import canonical, checked, digest, obj
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.launch_instructions import SELECTION_SCHEMA
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.practical_execution_operations import confined
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.practical_execution_records import ASSIGNMENT_SCHEMA, validate_assignment, validate_completion_proof, GENERIC_REQUESTED_JOB_SCHEMA
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.practical_execution_state import _immutable, _read
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.practical_receipt_information import PracticalReceiptInformation
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.hpc_work_planning.execution_job_submission.local_job_execution.terminal_execution import TerminalExecutionBehavior, operation_catalog
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.resource_records import INPUT_VERSION_SCHEMA

from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_utility_acquisition import is_native_blast_utility_target
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_database_acquisition import is_native_blast_database_target
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_standard_database_acquisition import is_standard_blast_database_target
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_hmmer_preparation_acquisition import is_native_hmmer_preparation_target
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.local_file_capture_results import LocalFileSourceResults, SELECTOR_SCHEMA as LOCAL_FILE_SOURCE_SELECTOR_SCHEMA, RECEIPT_VERSION as LOCAL_FILE_SOURCE_RECEIPT_VERSION, FILE_PROVIDER as LOCAL_FILE_SOURCE_PROVIDER, is_file_source_selector
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.a104_homology_execution import A104HomologyExecution, BLAST_GRADED_REQUEST_VERSION, BLAST_GRADED_REQUEST_SCHEMA, BLAST_GRADED_RETURN_SOURCE, BLAST_GRADED_RETURN_SCHEMA
from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.a104_execution_bindings import validate_primary_resource_bindings, validate_preparation_resource_binding, install_primary_result_readers, install_preparation_result_readers, requested_job_schemas, preparation_job_schemas, native_operation_contracts, preparation_operation_contracts, homology_api_contracts, result_selector_conditions, launch_request_schema
VERSION = 'execution_episode_v1'
LAUNCH_VERSION = 'execution_launch_assignment_v1'
RESULTS_VERSION = 'execution_results_assignment_v1'
RESULT_PROVIDER = 'episode.execution_result'
_CLOSED_CREDIT = 'execution_closed_operational_credit_v1'
ROLES = ('launch', 'launch_api', 'launch_local', 'launch_hpc', 'results')
KINDS = {'local': 'local', 'pbs_ssh': 'hpc', 'hmmer_api': 'api', 'api': 'api'}
ROLE_KINDS = {'launch_api': 'api', 'launch_local': 'local', 'launch_hpc': 'hpc'}
TEXT = {'type': 'string', 'minLength': 1}
OFFSET = {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 0}
LIMIT = {'type': 'integer', 'minimum': 1}
FILE_LIMIT = {**LIMIT, 'maximum': 1024 * 1024}
NATIVE_RESULT_ORIGIN = {'content_location': 'current_resource_filesystem', 'attempt_output_version': 'unverified', 'window_consistency': 'separate_reads_no_atomic_file_snapshot', 'completion_basis': 'requested_acquisition_and_observed_successful_attempt'}
NATIVE_RESULT_ORIGIN_SCHEMA = obj({key: {'type': 'string', 'enum': [value]} for key, value in NATIVE_RESULT_ORIGIN.items()})
RESULTS_SCHEMA = obj({'version': {'const': RESULTS_VERSION}, 'handoff_ref': TEXT, 'selector': {'type': 'object'}})
NATIVE_SELECTOR_SCHEMA = obj({'paths': {'type': 'array', 'minItems': 1, 'uniqueItems': True, 'items': TEXT}, 'path': TEXT, 'offset': OFFSET, 'limit': LIMIT}, [])

def launch_operation_catalog():
    """Declared launch operations, without a target/resource observation."""
    return [{'name': 'execution.capabilities', 'description': 'Read the actual caller-bound resource configuration and already recorded inventory; no discovery or selection.', 'input_schema': obj({})}]

def native_result_operation_catalog():
    """Actual local/PBS acquisition operators; execution still requires a target."""
    return [{'name': 'execution.results.status', 'description': 'Observe the exact handed-off physical attempt once.', 'input_schema': obj({})}, {'name': 'execution.results.collect', 'description': 'Observe the original attempt and acquire bounded first windows of the requested paths.', 'input_schema': obj({})}, {'name': 'execution.results.read', 'description': 'Acquire one selected bounded byte window within the original requested paths and interval.', 'input_schema': obj({'path': TEXT, 'offset': OFFSET, 'limit': FILE_LIMIT})}]

def _outcome(result=None, *, references=(), code=None):
    return {'status': 'invalid' if code else 'completed', 'record_refs': list(references), 'changed_record_refs': list(references), 'result': result, 'feedback': None if code is None else {'category': 'arguments_or_reference', 'code': code}}
from pathlib import Path
_AXIS_DIRECTORY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]

def _binding_source_bytes():
    return b''.join((p.read_bytes() for p in sorted(Path(__file__).parent.glob('*.py'))))

class ExecutionEpisodeRequests:

    def child_assignment_schema(self, parent, role):
        """A frozen HPC launch exposes only its already authorized request."""
        if parent.role == 'launch' and role == 'launch_hpc' and any((ancestor == 'hpc' for ancestor, _ in parent.path)):
            assignment = plain(parent.assignment)
            requests = [request for resource_id, request in assignment['requests'].items() if self._permitted(assignment, resource_id) and request.get('resource_kind') == 'hpc']
            if not requests:
                raise ValueError('frozen_hpc_launch_request_missing')
            return {'type': 'object', 'enum': requests}
        return self.assignment_schema(role)

    def assignment_schema(self, role, *, internal=False):
        self.credit_kind(role)
        if role == 'results':
            schema = deepcopy(RESULTS_SCHEMA)
            schema['properties']['selector'].setdefault('allOf', []).append({'if': {'required': ['version'], 'properties': {'version': {'const': 'local_file_source_selector_v1'}}}, 'then': deepcopy(LOCAL_FILE_SOURCE_SELECTOR_SCHEMA)})
            schema['properties']['selector']['allOf'].extend(result_selector_conditions())
            return schema
        if role == 'launch':
            schema = obj({'version': {'const': LAUNCH_VERSION}, 'requests': {'type': 'object', 'properties': {key: launch_request_schema(self._request_schema(key, selected=False, internal=internal, compact=False), key, self.resources[key].get('service')) for key in self.resources}, 'minProperties': 1, 'additionalProperties': False}, 'immutable_input_versions': {'type': 'array', 'items': deepcopy(INPUT_VERSION_SCHEMA)}, 'constraints': {'type': 'object'}})
            schema['properties']['launch_instructions'] = deepcopy(SELECTION_SCHEMA)
            return schema
        alternatives = [self._request_schema(key, selected=True, internal=internal) for key, config in self.resources.items() if KINDS[config['kind']] == ROLE_KINDS[role]]
        return {'anyOf': alternatives} if alternatives else {'not': {}}

    def _permitted(self, assignment, resource_id):
        constraints = assignment['constraints']
        kind = KINDS[self.resources[resource_id]['kind']]
        return resource_id in assignment['requests'] and ('allowed_resource_ids' not in constraints or resource_id in constraints['allowed_resource_ids']) and ('allowed_kinds' not in constraints or kind in constraints['allowed_kinds']) and ('resource_id' not in constraints or resource_id == constraints['resource_id']) and ('kind' not in constraints or kind == constraints['kind'])

    def prepare_assignment(self, parent, role, selection, scope, operation_key):
        selected = checked(selection, self.assignment_schema(role, internal=True), 'invalid_execution_assignment')
        if parent.role in ('hpc', 'hpc_execution') and role == 'launch':
            from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.hpc_launch_authentication import authenticate_launch
            authenticate_launch(parent, selected, operation_key, self.directory)
        if role == 'launch':
            selected = self._launch(selected, scope=scope)
            for request in selected['requests'].values():
                self._masking_inputs(parent, request)
                self._utility_inputs(parent, request)
            self._versions(selected['immutable_input_versions'], scope, context=parent)
            from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_database_result_publication import validate_native_job_inputs
            from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_standard_database_result_publication import validate_standard_blast_job_inputs
            for request in selected['requests'].values():
                validate_native_job_inputs(self.store, parent, request)
                validate_standard_blast_job_inputs(self.store, parent, request)
            return selected
        if role == 'results':
            recorded = self._recorded_results_assignment(parent, selected, scope, operation_key)
            if recorded is not None:
                return recorded
            masking_target = self._retained_masking_target(parent, selected, scope)
            utility_target = self._retained_utility_target(parent, selected, scope)
            target = utility_target if utility_target is not None else masking_target if masking_target is not None else self.job_progress_provider.targets.read_target(selected['handoff_ref'], scope)
            self._selector(selected, target)
            if is_file_source_selector(selected.get('selector')):
                self.local_file_sources.admit(parent, selected, target)
            if self._masking_selector(selected):
                self.native_blast_masking_results.validate_selected_inputs(parent, selected)
            if self._utility_selector(selected):
                self.native_blast_utility_results.validate_selected_inputs(parent, selected)
            if is_standard_blast_database_target(target):
                from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_standard_database_result_publication import validate_standard_blast_selected_inputs
                validate_standard_blast_selected_inputs(self.store, parent, selected['selector'], handoff_ref=selected['handoff_ref'])
            if is_native_blast_database_target(target):
                from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_database_result_publication import validate_selected_inputs
                validate_selected_inputs(self.store, parent, selected['selector'], handoff_ref=selected['handoff_ref'])
            from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.bvbrc_data_host import is_bvbrc_request
            if target['resource_kind'] == 'api' and is_bvbrc_request(target['assignment'].get('request')):
                self.api_execution.bvbrc_data.validate_inputs(parent, selected['selector'], request=target['assignment']['request'])
            return selected
        selected = self._validate_request(selected)
        if ROLE_KINDS[role] == 'api':
            selected = self.api_execution.validate_assignment(selected, scope=scope)
        if ROLE_KINDS[role] != KINDS[self.resources[selected['resource_id']]['kind']]:
            raise ValueError('execution_resource_kind_conflict')
        if parent.role != 'launch':
            raise ValueError('resource_child_role_owned_by_launch')
        original = self._launch(plain(parent.assignment))
        if role == 'launch_api':
            self._validate_blast_launch_selection(original, selected, scope)
        self._masking_inputs(parent, selected)
        self._utility_inputs(parent, selected)
        self._versions(original['immutable_input_versions'], scope, context=parent)
        from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_database_result_publication import validate_native_job_inputs
        from gene_annotation_episode.episodic_workflow.root.a104.native_blast_standard_database_result_publication import validate_standard_blast_job_inputs
        validate_native_job_inputs(self.store, parent, selected)
        validate_standard_blast_job_inputs(self.store, parent, selected)
        return selected

    def _request_schema(self, resource_id, *, selected, internal=False, compact=True):
        kind = KINDS[self.resources[resource_id]['kind']]
        schema = deepcopy(self.api_execution.assignment_schema(resource_id) if kind == 'api' else ASSIGNMENT_SCHEMA)
        if schema.get('type') != 'object' or not isinstance(schema.get('properties'), dict):
            raise ValueError('concrete_execution_assignment_schema_required')
        schema['properties']['resource_id'] = {'type': 'string', 'const': resource_id}
        if kind != 'api':
            schema['properties']['resource_kind'] = {'type': 'string', 'const': kind}
            alternatives = [*requested_job_schemas(self.resources[resource_id], kind, resource_id), *preparation_job_schemas(self.resources[resource_id], kind, resource_id)]
            schema['properties']['requested_job'] = {'anyOf': [deepcopy(GENERIC_REQUESTED_JOB_SCHEMA), *alternatives]} if alternatives else deepcopy(GENERIC_REQUESTED_JOB_SCHEMA)
        if selected and 'resource_id' not in schema['required']:
            schema['required'].append('resource_id')
        return schema

    def _validate_request(self, value, *, resource_id=None):
        resource_id = resource_id or value.get('resource_id')
        if resource_id not in self.resources:
            raise ValueError('execution_resource_not_bound')
        config = self.resources[resource_id]
        kind = KINDS[config['kind']]
        value = self.api_execution.validate_assignment(value) if kind == 'api' else validate_assignment(value)
        if value.get('resource_id', resource_id) != resource_id:
            raise ValueError('execution_resource_identity_conflict')
        if kind != 'api':
            if value['resource_kind'] != kind:
                raise ValueError('execution_resource_kind_conflict')
            confined(value['workspace'], config['workspace'])
            operations = self._practical[resource_id]._operations(kind)
            validator = getattr(operations, 'validate_assignment', None)
            if validator is not None:
                validator({**value, 'resource_id': resource_id})
        return value

    def _launch(self, value, *, scope=None):
        from .parent_launch_contract import parent_launch_schema
        value = checked(value, parent_launch_schema(self), 'invalid_execution_launch_assignment')
        for resource_id, request in value['requests'].items():
            if request.get('version') == BLAST_GRADED_REQUEST_VERSION:
                checked(request, BLAST_GRADED_REQUEST_SCHEMA, 'blast_database_grader_return_request_invalid')
                if request['resource_id'] != resource_id or self.resources[resource_id].get('service') != 'ncbi_blast':
                    raise ValueError('blast_database_grader_resource_conflict')
                continue
            self._validate_request(request, resource_id=resource_id)
            if scope is not None and KINDS[self.resources[resource_id]['kind']] == 'api':
                self.api_execution.validate_assignment(request, scope=scope)
        self._constraints(value['constraints'])
        return value

    @staticmethod
    def _constraints(constraints):
        for key in ('allowed_resource_ids', 'allowed_kinds'):
            if key in constraints and (not isinstance(constraints[key], list) or any((not isinstance(item, str) or not item for item in constraints[key]))):
                raise ValueError('invalid_execution_resource_constraints')
